question: In one year, the average monthly expenditure of Sapna was Rs. 1100 for the first 3 months of the year, Rs. 1000 for the next 5 months and Rs. 1200 for the last 4 months. If the total annual saving was Rs. 1300, then what was sapna's average monthly income?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Annual Expenditure = (3 × 1100) + (5 × 1000) + (4 × 1200) = Rs. 13100

Total Annual Income = Total Expenditure + Total Savings = 13100 + 1300 = Rs. 14400

Average Monthly Income = Total Income ÷ 12 = 14400 ÷ 12 = Rs. 1200

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average expenditure for first 3 months = Rs. 1100 / month

Average expenditure for next 5 months = Rs. 1000 / month

Average expenditure for last 4 months = Rs. 1200 / month

Total annual savings = Rs. 1300

**Formula Used:**

Total Income = Total Expenditure + Total Savings

Average Monthly Income = Total Annual Income ÷ 12
